dict.string: homie listens while you talk to it. Audio is processed on this Mac and never uploaded.
homie turns your voice into text with Apple's on-device speech recognition. Nothing is sent to a server.
homie controls Music, creates Apple Notes and switches Arc tabs when you ask.
homie reads your calendar when you ask about your schedule. It never creates, edits or deletes events.
homie reads, creates and completes your reminders when you ask.
